transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’m here because things got… kind of intense. I’d barely finished moving into my new apartment, and then suddenly I was saying yes to mentoring sessions, taking extra client prototypes, redoing my whole portfolio—like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint.
Did you feel unusually happy or euphoric during this intense period?

Yeah… kind of. Earlier this month I felt really upbeat, almost wired. But it wasn’t just happy—one minute I’d feel electric, and then I’d snap at someone over some tiny delay, like they were getting in my way on purpose.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling sad or depressed recently?

Yeah… lately I’ve been waking up with this heavy, gray feeling in my chest. Even when it’s quiet and nothing’s really wrong, I’ll just feel like I could cry over something stupid, like a mug left in the sink.
How long have you been experiencing these periods of feeling sad or depressed?
Since the separation… so, about 11 months, I guess. It’s not constant every single day, but the heavier stretches started around then. The move just made it feel sharper.
Did you have any periods where you didn't need much sleep and still felt rested?
Yeah. For a few nights I only slept maybe three or four hours, but I’d wake up feeling like I was fine… like I should just use the time and get things done.
Did you ever feel so good or hyper that you got into trouble, like spending too much money or doing something reckless?

Yeah… I mean, not “trouble” like police or anything. But I did spend way too much. I bought these expensive light fixtures, some design software add-ons, and even a last-minute flight for a trip I really couldn’t afford. At the time it felt fine, and then later I saw what it did to my savings.
How long did these intense, upbeat periods typically last?
It’s been… mostly since I moved into the apartment, about a month ago. The up-and-down part has felt more intense since then.
Did these intense periods seem to be triggered by anything in particular, like stressful events or significant changes?
I don’t know if it was triggered exactly… it’s just been since I moved into the apartment, about a month ago, that the whole up-and-down thing got more intense.
Have you ever had a period of feeling extremely low or depressed that lasted for two years or more?
Not two years, no. The heavier depressed stretches have really been more since the separation… about 11 months ago. Even before I moved, but the move made it feel sharper.
Did you notice any pattern or cycle to these ups and downs, like a regular shift between feeling really up and really down?
I’m not sure there’s a regular pattern. It doesn’t feel predictable, at least not that I’ve noticed. It just kind of swings around.
Have you ever had a period of feeling extremely high or euphoric that lasted for several days or more at a time?

Yeah… earlier this month, I guess. I felt almost electric sometimes, really upbeat, but then I’d snap over stupid little things—like a contractor being delayed, or my sister taking too long. It felt bigger than it should have.
Did you ever feel so irritable or impatient during these intense periods that you had difficulty getting along with others?

Yeah… I think so. Earlier this month I was really upbeat, almost wired, and then I’d get irritated so fast. Like if a contractor was late or my sister took too long, I’d snap like they were doing it on purpose. It made things tense.
Did you ever have a period where you felt extremely high or euphoric and also had increased energy, decreased need for sleep, and impulsive behaviors all at the same time?

Sort of… earlier this month I felt really upbeat, almost electric. But it wasn’t just happy, I’d snap at people over tiny delays, like a contractor being late or my sister taking too long. It felt… intense.

Did you ever have a period where all these intense feelings and behaviors happened together at the same time, like feeling really high, having lots of energy, needing less sleep, and doing impulsive things?

Yeah… I mean, earlier this month it kind of all felt intense together. I’d feel almost electric, really upbeat, and then suddenly I’d snap over tiny things—like a contractor being delayed or my sister taking too long. It felt like they were blocking me on purpose, even though… I know that sounds like a lot.
Did you ever have a distinct period of time where you felt extremely high or euphoric and this feeling lasted for most of the day for at least one week?

I don’t know if it was a whole week. Earlier this month, for stretches I felt almost… electric, really upbeat, and then I’d get irritated and snap at my sister or a contractor over little delays, like they were trying to block me. But the exact timing is kind of hard for me to say.
Did this extremely high or euphoric feeling last for at least four consecutive days?
I think so… it’s hard to pin down exactly, but this whole intense up-and-down thing has been going on since I moved into the apartment, about a month ago.
Did you have a period where you felt extremely high or euphoric that lasted for at least four consecutive days without any breaks in between?

I… I’m not totally sure there were no breaks. Earlier this month there were days where I felt really wired, almost electric and upbeat, and then I’d suddenly snap at my sister or a contractor over tiny delays, like they were doing it to me on purpose. But whether that was four straight days without any letup… I don’t know.
Did you have a period where you felt extremely high or euphoric that lasted at least four consecutive days without any breaks in between?

I can’t say for sure it was four days straight with no breaks. Earlier this month I did feel kind of electric and upbeat, and then I’d get really irritated and snap at my sister or a contractor over small delays, like they were trying to block me. But the exact stretch of days… I’m not sure.
Did you have a period where you felt extremely high or euphoric that lasted at least four consecutive days without any breaks in between, where you can clearly remember it was that long?

I can’t clearly remember it being four full days with no break. What I do remember is earlier this month feeling almost electric and really upbeat, and then suddenly getting irritated and snapping at my sister or a contractor over little delays, like they were blocking me on purpose.
Did you have a period where you felt extremely high or euphoric and this feeling lasted for most of the day for at least four consecutive days?

I don’t really know if it was most of the day for four days. Earlier this month I had times where I felt almost electric, really upbeat, and then I’d snap at my sister or a contractor over tiny delays, like they were blocking me on purpose. But I’m not sure about the exact length.
